title: Suspect arrested over fire at Hitler’s ‘Eagle’s Nest’ retreat in Bavaria
summary_full: About 200 firefighters deployed to tackle blaze at former Nazi mountain retreat in remote part of southern GermanyGerman police have arrested a suspect after a fire ripped through Adolf Hitler’s former mountain retreat in Bavaria, leaving the historic Nazi meeting place – known as the Eagle’s Nest – largely destroyed.About 200 firefighters were deployed on Friday night to tackle the blaze at the Nazi dictator’s remote, purpose-built Kehlsteinhaus residence, a protected building on the peak of Obersalzberg in southern Germany.
